_about: Where the sources disagree about Harmony (HM). Nothing here is settled until checked in person on board. The map data keeps the 'using' value until then; never overwrite it silently from a new scrape. Every new scrape (a new SVG profile, more Royal app screenshots) is compared with the data and each difference is added here. After the sailing, the owner's on-board log settles each entry: set 'status' to 'confirmed' with 'truth', then fix the data (overrides, venue table) and rebuild. See tools/shipmap/README.md, Conflicts.
